correctness.rationale: Full initial z-interval is dyadic and base ternary digit 0/1 halves its length, digit 2 doubles unless already saturated. Consequently h_n=M_n-S_n and saturation exactly a running maximum. Reversing independent ternary increments produces a ballot path weighted two per downstep, with coefficient sum 2^j(C(n,j)-C(n,j-1)). Weighted Catalan return GF yields 2/(1-2z+sqrt(1-8z^2)); its two dominant square-root singularities give distinct even/odd constants. For dimension upper bound weighted cylinder summation controls limsup h_n<=H; lower bound concat negative Dyck bridges followed by one positive digit and take m to infinity. SLLN gives Lebesgue zero. Independently enumerated all ternary words through length 10, reproducing reflected lengths and counts. Finite enumeration alone is not a proof of dimension or asymptotics.
